Description.SourceString:
The dragonkin discovered a unique and powerful resource in their time on Ashenfall, the blood of a goddess – Lougrim. She was a moon deity, in-tune with the natural world, the forests and a source of great vitality. Her blood carries some of those properties. 

If imbibed, even small amounts of the blood, centuries old, can enhance one’s vital spark, making you hardier and healthier. You can take more damage, survive greater threats, overcome the most dangerous challenges. 

The blood was kept in a number of urns, which were separated and hidden across Ashenfall, in the hope that the resource wouldn’t easily be destroyed. It was to be a linchpin in their great endeavours, until Kuldra laid those lofty dreams to rest. Once they were buried, deep within the earth, but time, and other, more mysterious sources, have brought them to the surface just in time for your arrival. 

Anyone, and by that, I mean you, dear reader, can use the power of these urns for yourself. Explore Ashenfall and seek out these hidden locations; take the power of a goddess for your own. 

Whilst the blood may be weaker than before, it will still make you healthier, increasing your ability to stand against the great treats of Ashenfall.
